# requires: transfer
#
# A record that declared the ranges model, taken over by a runner with nothing
# but a prefix to report. The declaration is CARRIED, not derived -- the job
# layer cannot rediscover it, because what it describes lives inside a field
# that is opaque there -- so a writer that stops having holes to report has to
# withdraw it, and nothing else will.
#
# Left declared, `content` names a data model the checkpoint does not carry, and
# every reader that trusts the declaration is wrong about the same thing: it
# looks for `verified`, finds nothing, and cannot tell "no holes" from "written
# by somebody who never heard of ranges" -- which is the one distinction the
# declaration exists to make.
submit A size=64 digest=good src=file
claim A alpha 5000
progress A alpha 40 {"verified_prefix":8,"verified":[[0,8],[16,40]]}
release A alpha
run A beta
state A

# expect 5: ok state=transferred
# expect 5: done=64
# expect 5: content=abstraction.job/base@1 [JOB-D2]
